slice: MP8 — the six-lane evidence slice (the slides lane: the mp7 recorded gap, closed)
law: The codec tolerance law (see scripts/benchmark-lib.mts): a re-run of scripts/benchmark-slides.mts must produce ffprobe-IDENTICAL container metadata (codec h264, 480x854, 24 fps, 144 frames, duration within 0.06 s) and a cross-run PSNR at or above 30 dB against this baseline. Byte-identity is never pinned — libx264 is not byte-stable across runs/environments. A DELIBERATE visual change re-baselines on purpose by re-running the benchmark and committing the new baseline — that commit IS the review moment.
fixture: A 3-slide hand-authored deck (statement/counter/bars, fixed text, 2000 ms per slide, 24 fps, motion on at intensity 10) through the REAL kinetic pass (renderKineticSlideClips: chromium + slideFrameAt + ffmpeg), concated and delivered at 480x854. Zero AI spend — the LLM deck planner is deliberately not called.
